parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the door, shelves, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: The first shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: The second shelf is another horizontal board inside the cabinet, similar to the first shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: The third shelf is the topmost or bottommost horizontal board inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a surface for storing or supporting items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
